Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting local governments and state agencies from mandating the installation of fire sprinkler systems in agricultural structures.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting local governments and state agenciesfrom mandating the installation of fire sprinkler systems inagricultural structures; and adding a new section to chapter 19.27 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Nothing in this chapter authorizes a county, city, or stateagency to require the installation or use of a fire sprinkler system inan agricultural structure. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits the voluntary installationand use of fire sprinkler systems in agricultural structures.
